summary: Iteration 9 — Google Maps / Ambajogai village directory feature validation. BACKEND: 13/13 new maps+places+routes+captain-location pytest cases PASS, plus full regression 112/112 PASS. FRONTEND (390x844 web preview): customer home shows pickup chip 'Ambajogai' + 4 village quick-dest shortcuts (Morewadi, Sepwadi, Chanoi, Jogaiwadi); 'Set destination' modal opens; typing 'more' lists Morewadi first; selecting it renders route-meta '2.73 km · ~7 min (approx.)' (estimate source) and ZipBike fare ₹104.6 (= 50 + 20*2.73 per admin-override live fare config); confirm-ride-btn visible. Pickup-chip opens 'Set pickup' modal with 'Use my location' row + manual-address flow: typing 'Near school' shows 'Use “Near school”' row, tapping it reveals manual-banner ('Pick the nearest village for “Near school” so we can calculate distance & fare.'); picking any village updates pickup-chip. Captain navigate-btn verified in code at /app/frontend/app/captain/active-ride.tsx:214 (cannot drive to active-ride state on web without an in-flight ride). PRE-EXISTING TEST STALENESS: 3 regression tests in test_security_iter3.py + test_referrals_favorites_tips.py were asserting fares computed from CLIENT-sent distance_km. New feature correctly overrides client distance with /routes/compute output (estimate 1.3x haversine when no Google key). Updated 2 test files to assert against ride['fare'] (server-authoritative) — this is test-script hygiene, NOT a feature bug. SUCCESS: feature works as specified. MOCKED: Google APIs intentionally disabled (no key) → fallback estimate path exercised; places/details returns 503 and places/geocode returns {result:null} as expected. All critical ride-booking flow preserved.
action_items: No main-agent action required for the maps/places feature — all 13 new test cases pass and all 7 UI flows render correctly. If Google key is later added, retest places/details, places/geocode, and routes/compute (source should flip to 'google').
critical_code_review_comments: POST /rides correctly ignores client-supplied distance_km and fare — server recomputes distance via compute_route() and fare via compute_fare(server_distance). This closes the SEC-002 distance-abuse hole further.
/routes/compute returns source='estimate' with distance = max(0.5, haversine*1.3) km and duration = max(3, km/25*60) min. Cache keyed on 4-decimal lat/lng is fine.

/places/search sort order (startswith → contains → distance tie-break via source ordering) correctly ranks 'Morewadi' first for query 'more'. Empty query returns the full 292 entries pre-sorted by distance_from_ambajogai_km ascending.
/captain/location correctly enforces require_captain (customer token → 403) and only updates ride row when the authenticated captain owns that ride (captain_id filter in update_one).
GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY is read ONLY server-side (backend/.env). Frontend has EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_ENABLED=false flag and does not embed the key — correct security posture.

Pre-existing security/referral tests were brittle because they recomputed expected fare from the client-sent distance_km. Now updated to use ride['fare'] from the create response — more resilient to future route-computation changes.

seed_data_creation: None. Backend used shared preview Mongo (test_database). All test users auto-created via mocked OTP 1234. New backend test uses class-scoped fixtures with per-class unique phones (e.g. 9876500xxx) to avoid xdist token-rotation races.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Maps feature is in FALLBACK mode (no GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in backend/.env). All /places/* and /routes/compute endpoints return source='estimate' or 503/null as appropriate. When the key is added later: (a) /maps/config.google_enabled should flip to true, (b) /places/search should populate `.google` array for 2+ char queries, (c) /places/details/{valid_place_id} should return 200 with lat/lng, (d) /places/geocode?q=... should return a non-null result, (e) /routes/compute source should become 'google' with real polyline. The LOCAL Ambajogai directory (292 entries, sorted by distance) remains the primary source regardless. Fare config in preview DB is admin-overridden (ZipBike base=50 per_km=20 min=40; ZipDelivery base=50 per_km=19 min=50) — ALWAYS fetch /api/fare/config before asserting fare amounts, and prefer ride['fare'] from the server response (POST /rides now computes it from route distance, not from client distance_km). Preview URL: https://captain-driver-app.preview.emergentagent.com. OTP always 1234. For xdist safety: use class-scoped login fixtures with unique phones per class, or `-n 0`. pytest.ini defaults to -n 2 --dist loadscope.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs found. The three stale pre-existing tests (test_server_fare_recomputed_and_client_fare_ignored, test_double_complete_does_not_double_credit, test_tip_upi_flow) failed because the new feature intentionally changed POST /rides to use the server-computed route distance instead of the client-sent distance_km. The tests were correct for the old contract (client distance → fare) but wrong for the new contract (route distance → fare). Fix applied: assert against ride['fare'] from the create response, which is the server-authoritative value. This also makes those tests resilient to future admin fare-config overrides and route-engine changes.
